title: It's About Time | KEY.co
description_expanded: The outdoor oasis features a shimmering private pool, fire pit, and a fully equipped grilling station surrounded by lush landscaping and breathtaking Gulf vistas. Inside, the gourmet kitchen boasts high-end appliances and a waterfall island perfect for creating culinary delights, while multiple dining and living areas ensure effortless entertaining. Spacious en-suite bedrooms provide serene escapes, including a luxurious primary suite with a spa-like bath and balcony. The top floor offers a media room with a kitchenette and a Gulf-facing terrace for sunset cocktails, while the charming carriage house adds extra privacy and versatility. Located in the exclusive gated community of Pelican Pointe, “It’s About Time” invites you to bask in the beauty of the coast and create memories to last a lifetime. Perched on the shores of the Gulf of Mexico, “It’s About Time” is a masterpiece of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm, offering the perfect backdrop for unforgettable gatherings. This eight-bedroom, eight-bathroom retreat, complete with two half-baths, spans an expansive main house and private carriage house, providing the ultimate haven for family vacations or multi-family getaways. Every detail has been meticulously crafted, from the soaring ceilings and sunlit interiors to the seamless blend of contemporary design and beachside elegance. With panoramic Gulf views, private beach access, and a wealth of amenities, this home promises a retreat where every moment feels extraordinary.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
